$comment: Hand-checked extract of demos/interaction-benchmark/apps/<id>/BENCH.md as of 2026-09-22. Every entry cites its source file. Deployed URLs and the runtime actually used on Vercel live in deployments.json, not here.

entrants.name: Markless

versions.note: Built from this repository's working tree, not a published release; the measured source revision is recorded per run.

entrants.prereleaseSummary: Unreleased working tree; Nitro v3 beta
entrants.renderingNote: SSR on every request through Nitro; the router plugin renders each page.
entrants.activation: Resume: the browser continues the server's work instead of hydrating; components do not re-run in the browser. Built with experimentalNativePacking and intent link preloading.
entrants.delivery: About 71.7 KB gzip JS over 6 scripts on / at scaffold time; one ~68 KB chunk is modulepreloaded on every page (BENCH.md, 'Client JS on /').
entrants.vercelRuntime: Node (Nitro vercel preset; BENCH.md records nodejs24.x chosen by the preset)

variants.label: default
variants.note: experimentalNativePacking + linkPreloading: intent, same as the docs site.

variants.label: viewport
variants.note: Same app with viewport link preloading: after the page settles, on-screen links download (never run) their destination files at low priority. Source apps/markless-viewport, runner target markless-viewport.

tunings.default: "intent" (destination files download on hover, focus or pointerdown)
tunings.why: Navigation files for links on screen are already downloaded when the user clicks, so a client navigation needs no network round. Starts only after the page's own modulepreloads finished (after load or the first input) and the browser is idle; two downloads at a time, fetchpriority low, paused by each new input; skipped for Save-Data and 2g.

deviations: BENCH.md was written before the contract existed; its route and test-id notes are from the scaffold packet.

Findings at scaffold time: a page with several sibling root elements failed the build; a Link in document.tsrx caused a full reload; hashed /build/* chunks were not marked immutable by the Nitro preset. Later framework fixes are tracked on the goal board, not in this file.
entrants.earlyInput: Not stated in BENCH.md; see early-phase failure counts

entrants.name: Qwik v2 + Qwik Router
entrants.prereleaseSummary: Qwik v2 beta (npm latest points at the beta)
entrants.renderingNote: SSR on every request through the Qwik Router Vercel Edge adapter; nothing prerendered.
entrants.activation: Resume: server state is serialized, no hydration; event handlers load lazily through the Qwik loader, and a preloader fetches bundles by probability after load.
entrants.delivery: Default smart entry strategy. 42.4 KB gzip modulepreloaded in the SSR head; about 72 KB after load plus 3 s idle on / (BENCH.md, 'Client JS per route').
entrants.navigationNote: Client navigation through Qwik Router Link.
entrants.vercelRuntime: Edge (Qwik v2 ships only a Vercel Edge adapter; PM ruling: disclosed, and the local controlled-host runs are the like-for-like check)

variants.label: default
variants.note: Default production settings (external async Qwik loader module, smart bundling, default preloader).

variants.label: tuned
variants.note: Same app with three documented Qwik settings: inline Qwik loader, one bundle per route plus a shared-chrome bundle, ssrPreloads 8. Source apps/qwik-tuned, runner target qwik-tuned, deployed as mlbench-qwik-tuned.

tunings.why: Removes the request before listeners exist; clicks after first paint are captured.
tunings.source: https://qwik.dev/docs/advanced/qwikloader/ ("we recommend delivering Qwikloader in an inlined <script> tag"); RenderOptions.qwikLoader JSDoc in @qwik.dev/core

tunings.why: One bundle per route (overview, records, settings) and one for root/layout/tree; 60 client JS files become 41. useComputed$ segments stay separate (Qwik skips them in the manual map).
tunings.source: https://qwik.dev/docs/guides/bundle/ (qwikVite() plugin, manual entryStrategy with the bundle() helper)

tunings.why: The route and chrome bundles are modulepreloaded from the SSR HTML.

deviations: Qwik Router's CSRF origin check answers 403 instead of 405 to a non-GET /api/settings request without an Origin header; the JSON POST is unaffected.
edit-name uses autoFocus so showModal() focuses it; Chromium logs an autofocus warning. No behavior change.
entrants.activationShort: Resume (no hydration); lazy handlers via Qwik loader
entrants.earlyInput: Qwik loader (async module in head) dispatches to lazily loaded handlers

entrants.name: Octane

versions.note: npm latest; README says status: beta; pre-1.0

entrants.renderingNote: SSR at request time from the Vite plugin's app layer (Octane's own fullstack scaffold).
entrants.activation: Hydration with hydrateRoot; early pointer clicks are captured and replayed.
entrants.delivery: The same 7 chunks load on every route, 103.7 KB gzip, runtime about 85 KB (BENCH.md, 'Client JavaScript per route').
entrants.navigationNote: App pushState single-App pattern from Octane's own examples (PM ruling: its idiomatic client navigation; labeled).
deviations: Navigation uses history.pushState plus a popstate re-render, following Octane's app-layer examples; the app layer does not provide a client router.
The app stores scroll position in history.state and restores it after the popstate render.
The app smoke listed overview-toggle early as a known intermittent framework failure (see observations).
observations: Keyboard activation (Space) pressed before the runtime loads was lost in about half of local attempts, while pointer clicks at the same moment were replayed.

entrants.name: React Router (framework mode)
entrants.renderingNote: ssr: true; each route rendered per request, route modules split per route.
entrants.activation: React hydration of the whole document; the router then takes over navigation. React Compiler off (template default).
entrants.delivery: 7 JS files, about 115 KB gzip on / (BENCH.md, 'Client JS and CSS on initial load'). Lazy route discovery fetches /__manifest once after hydration.
entrants.vercelRuntime: Node (Vercel React Router preset; Node 22 or 24 per BENCH.md)
deviations: Settings submit goes through useFetcher().submit to a clientAction that sends the contract's single JSON POST; flushSync: true commits the pending UI in the submit event.
NavLink adds framework-owned class and data-discover attributes.
entrants.earlyInput: Not stated in BENCH.md; see early-phase failure counts

entrants.name: Remix 3
entrants.renderingNote: SSR at request time; no bundling build. The asset server transforms and minifies each browser module on request (unbundled ESM, import map, modulepreload links).
entrants.activation: Each clientEntry component hydrates after its modules load; no capture or replay of earlier input.
entrants.delivery: About 67 unbundled modules, 54 KB gzip on / (BENCH.md, 'Client JS on initial load'). The app server sends uncompressed responses; the controlled local host adds the shared compressing proxy.
entrants.navigationNote: The runtime intercepts same-origin navigations through the Navigation API and fetches the destination's server-rendered HTML.
entrants.vercelRuntime: Node 24.x (own configuration; Remix 3 has no official Vercel adapter)

variants.label: default
variants.note: Scaffold defaults: no fingerprinting, no compression middleware. A fingerprinted/compressed tuned variant is documented, not built.

deviations: No build step exists; pnpm build writes build-info.json with the build id.
settings-form keeps action/method for progressive enhancement; the measured path is always the JSON fetch.
Framework hydration markers, an import map and about 60 modulepreload links are in the HTML (counted).
observations: Early inputs that arrive before a clientEntry hydrates were lost in local runs (overview-toggle early every run; other early cases occasionally).
entrants.earlyInput: Not captured; lost in local runs

entrants.name: SolidStart v2
entrants.renderingNote: Streaming SSR by default; the client hydrates.
entrants.activation: Hydration; captured click and input events that arrive before hydration are replayed.
entrants.delivery: About 24 KB gzip JS on /, plus a 4.5 KB gzip stylesheet that includes unused dev-toolbar CSS (BENCH.md, 'Client bytes per route').
entrants.vercelRuntime: Node (Nitro vercel preset, nodejs24.x at scaffold time; region not yet configured)
deviations: <Router scrollRestoration> (documented, non-default) is enabled; without it Back lands at scrollY 0.
@solidjs/meta is added for <Title> as in the official template (bytes counted).
<A> adds framework-owned class and link attributes.
observations: Production builds ship SolidStart dev-toolbar CSS as a render-blocking stylesheet (the toolbar JS itself is removed).

entrants.name: SvelteKit (Svelte 5)

versions.note: newest release inside Kit's peer range

entrants.activation: Hydration (Svelte 5 runes); no replay of events that arrive before hydration.
entrants.delivery: 10 JS files, about 34.6 KB gzip on / (BENCH.md, 'Client bytes on initial load'). Preload hints are sent as an HTTP Link header.
entrants.navigationNote: SvelteKit client router; data-sveltekit-preload-data="hover" kept from the default template.
deviations: Disclosure state lives in the layout, which stays mounted across client navigation (allowed by the contract).
Hover preloading of route code is the default template's setting.
observations: No replay of input that arrives before hydration; early clicks on slow networks can be lost.

entrants.name: Ripple
entrants.renderingNote: Buffered SSR from the plugin's production entry; the generated client entry hydrates.
entrants.activation: Hydration; no queue or replay of events that arrive before the client entry runs.
entrants.delivery: About 21.3 KB gzip JS on /; AppShell chunk is not in the modulepreload list and is discovered late (BENCH.md, 'Client JS and CSS on initial load').
entrants.navigationNote: Ripple 0.4.7 has no client router, so header links are document navigations (PM ruling). Navigation cases are labeled document navigation and never compared as client-navigation latency.
entrants.vercelRuntime: Node (adapter-vercel; runtime auto-detected from local Node at scaffold time, must be set to 22.x before deploy)
deviations: Navigation is document navigation (see above).
Each page renders <AppShell route=...> instead of a RenderRoute layout, which cannot see the matched route during SSR.
Dialog Escape uses onCancel with delegated: false; selection uses track(new Set()) instead of RippleSet.
observations: The Vercel function traced to about 18 MB on disk for a three-route app (build tooling traced into the function).
